result.verdict: The earlier blockers look fixed based on the diff. I found no concrete defect that should stop this, but the final gates still need to run: the full unit suite after these changes, the installed-package docs checks and the tooling run. Until they pass, don't call this complete. What's left is small wording and evidence-scope fixes.
risks: The second records test is called 'UI retry', but it calls application.getView().triggerMethod('retry:records') directly instead of clicking the retry control. The summary says 'handlers used only UI triggers', which this test does not show. Either click the actual retry button (or whatever control raises the trigger), or rename the test and narrow the claim.

The failed-recovery test only reaches the second .catch if showRecordsError rejects while the live child still owns the content Region. That depends on how showRecordsError is written today. If it later stops rejecting, the test fails for a reason unrelated to the boundary it is meant to cover. Consider asserting the cause explicitly (for example the MN0003 text in the console report).

The JSDoc examples now depend on '@mnjs/adapters/dom/lit-html' and 'lit-html'. The rebuilt declarations only prove that escapeHtml is gone. Nothing shows that this import path resolves in the packed candidate. Confirm the subpath is one of the five exported adapter subpaths.

View example: Region content is placed inside a Lit-rendered static <div class="body">. That is safe only because the div has no bindings. It sits close to the readme warning 'Do not independently replace Lit's contents'. It is acceptable, but a reader could extend it wrongly.
incorrectAssumptions: 'Records handlers used only UI triggers' is not fully supported. One of the two new tests calls triggerMethod programmatically.

The CollectionView wording changed from 'manual children without a source model' to 'manual children whose models are absent from the collection'. That drops the case of a manual child with no model at all. If such a child still sorts first, say so, e.g. 'manual children with no model, or a model not in the collection'.

The readme phrase 'docs/packages/adapters.md beside its resolved marionette/package.json' suggests the same directory. The file is actually under docs/ relative to the package root. Say 'under the package root that contains marionette/package.json'.
missingTests: Application: reselecting the displayed root destroys a pending prepared replacement. This is newly documented; point to an existing test or add one.
Application: setView/showView reject a View shown directly through a Region with MN0003. This is newly stated; confirm a test asserts this exact code for both methods.
CollectionView: a manual child with no model under the default source-order comparator, if the docs are meant to keep covering it.

Packed candidate: docs/packages/utils.md and docs/packages/adapters.md are present in the tarball at the path the readmes give. This may already be covered by the packed-guide checks; if so, cite them.
simplifications: Drive the retry test through the real UI control, the same way the close test does, instead of triggerMethod. That makes the 'UI-intent boundary' claim literally true.
The openRecords and restartRecords chains are identical. Extracting one recover(promise) helper would remove the duplication, but only if the example still reads clearly without it.
nextSteps: Fix or rename the triggerMethod-based retry test, or narrow the 'UI triggers only' claim.
Tighten the manual-child sorting wording and the readme 'beside' phrasing.
Name the tests that cover the two new Application sentences, or add them.
Run the full unit suite, the installed-package docs checks (with no concurrent builds) and the tooling run. Report the actual results, including any failures, before claiming the work is complete.
